## Folder Properties

retention-tab =
    .label = Retention Policy

retention-use-default =
    .label = Use my account settings
    .accesskey = U

## Account Settings

retention-button =
    .label = Retention Policy

retention-dialog-title = Retention Policy

## Common strings

retention-description = To recover disk space, old messages can be permanently deleted.

retention-description-imap = To recover disk space, old messages can be permanently deleted, both local copies and originals on the remote server.

retention-description-pop = To recover disk space, old messages can be permanently deleted, including originals on the remote server.

retention-retain-all =
    .label = Don’t delete any messages
    .accesskey = n

retention-retain-by-num-headers =
    .label = Delete all but the most recent
    .accesskey = b

retention-messages = messages

retention-retain-by-age =
    .label = Delete messages more than
    .accesskey = t

retention-days-old = days old

retention-always-keep-starred =
    .label = Always keep starred messages
    .accesskey = k

retention-removal-warning = This setting will permanently delete old messages from the remote server AND your local storage. Are you sure you want to proceed?
